[Verse 1]
The ferry leaves at half past four
The gulls know every word I say
I count the boxes, hour by hour
And half the island looks away

[Chorus]
Hold the rope and count the tide
And let the harbour open wide
I fold the ticket in my hand
And watch the island shrink to sand

[Verse 2]
The shop has shuttered till the spring
The paint is peeling, line by line
I leave my boots and everything
The winter keeps whatever's mine

[Chorus]
Hold the rope and count the tide
And let the harbour open wide
I fold the ticket in my hand
And watch the island shrink to sand

[Bridge]
Next summer I will take this boat
The other way and nothing more
The island will not know my coat
The way it only knew before

[Chorus]
Hold the rope and count the tide
And let the harbour open wide
I fold the ticket in my hand
And watch the island shrink to sand
